text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, ow-ow-ow... I really did a number 
on myself this time, didn't I...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Getting injured during practice... I 
wonder if this is dragging down the other 
girls' motivation...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did I end up scaring him...!? Oh no, 
what have I done...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That's it...! I'm going to go parade 
around the school for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's hard, and it hurts, but... I have to 
show them I'm doing well so they won't 
worry...!"
choice_data_list: Don't worry, just get some rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Some of the Umamusume might 
be feeling anxious because of me...
choice_data_list:
People can tell when you're forcing 
yourself, you know.

It's obvious when you're pushing yourself, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, indeed…… Stoking even more anxiety 
with an unseemly appearance would be a 
bit……"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this sucks... What even is an 
extreme otaku without her mobility?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is pure love... Ugh, I 
want to turn this love into action...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I cheered up the dejected Agnes Digital 
and had her get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Alright! I'll be on my way right away!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, ow-ow-ouch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haaah...! Calm down, just picture 
your bias. Clear your mind of all 
thoughts, and even the pain becomes 
precious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing through the movement really was a 
bad idea. It seems to have delayed the 
injury's recovery."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right, camouflage time! Digitan is 
totally fine! Ultra healthy! Watch over 
me, my beloved Umamusume-chans...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? As I'm walking, I might 
actually be feeling a lot better...

text_block_list.name: Digital's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Digital-san! You can walk already? 
Thank goodness~ What a relief~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
O-O-Of course I am~! Look, see? There's 
absolutely nothing to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! I managed to protect that 
precious smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Man, her smile was just so healing! There 
really is nothing better for revitalizing 
your spirit than an Umamusume-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to some light exercise and the 
power of her oshi's smile, Agnes Digital 
recovered in no time.
